Card Q&A.q: How long does the 2000 DP boost from this card's inherited effect last?
I activate this card's inherited effect to boost its DP. Later, this digivolution card is trashed. Does the DP boost go away?

a: No. If your opponent doesn't block, the effect doesn't activate.

Regardless of what the target of attack is, the effect activates when a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards attacks an opponent's Digimon and has its attack target changed to a blocking opponent's Digimon.
